translation: Flavor bitter, warm, non-toxic. It governs edema (水腫), wind-edema (風腫), removes heat of the bladder (膀胱熱), cold-damage (傷寒), cold-heat and evil-qi (寒熱邪氣), wind-stroke (中風), cramping of the hands and feet (手腳攣急), diarrhea (泄), disperses carbuncle swelling and evil bindings (癰腫、惡結), the various snail-scabies and ringworm (諸蝸疥癬), insect sores (蟲瘡), frees the interstices (通腠理), and benefits the nine [orifices] (利九)...
